raw_text: Assam NRC supplementary list excludes 15,000 more names from Barak Valley, predominantly Bengali-speaking Hindu and Muslim families. Protests have paralysed life in Silchar, Karimganj and Hailakandi districts. Opposition parties demand Chief Minister's intervention. The BJP-led government has called the list a routine administrative update.
